units.leftText: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
units.rightText: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy,

units.leftText: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
rightNotes: 1:2 SBL, NE, and WH God the Father

units.leftText: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,
units.rightText: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
leftNotes: 1:3 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

units.leftText: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
units.rightText: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.

units.leftText: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.
units.rightText: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.

units.leftText: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
units.rightText: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,

units.leftText: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
units.rightText: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels

units.leftText: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
units.rightText: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

units.leftText: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
units.rightText: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,

units.leftText: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
units.rightText: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.

units.leftText: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,
units.rightText: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,

units.leftText: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
rightNotes: 1:12 Or the grace of our God and Lord, Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you
units.rightText: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,

units.leftText: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
units.rightText: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.

units.leftText: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.
units.rightText: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness — the son of destruction — is revealed.

units.leftText: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
units.rightText: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.

units.leftText: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?
units.rightText: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?

units.leftText: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
units.rightText: And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.

units.leftText: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
units.rightText: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.

units.leftText: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
units.rightText: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.

units.leftText: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
units.rightText: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,

units.leftText: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
units.rightText: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.

units.leftText: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
units.rightText: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,

units.leftText: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
units.rightText: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.

units.leftText: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
units.rightText: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
rightNotes: 2:13 Or God has chosen you as the firstfruits

units.leftText: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
units.rightText: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.

units.leftText: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
units.rightText: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,

units.leftText: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
units.rightText: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.

units.leftText: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,
units.rightText: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.

units.leftText: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
units.rightText: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.

units.leftText: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
units.rightText: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.

units.leftText: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
units.rightText: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.

units.leftText: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.
units.rightText: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.

units.leftText: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.
units.rightText: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.

units.leftText: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
units.rightText: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,

units.leftText: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.
units.rightText: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. Instead, in labor and toil, we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you.

units.leftText: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
units.rightText: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.

units.leftText: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
units.rightText: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”

units.leftText: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
units.rightText: For we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives, accomplishing nothing, but being busybodies.

units.leftText: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
units.rightText: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.

units.leftText: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
units.rightText: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.

units.leftText: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
units.rightText: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.

units.leftText: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
units.rightText: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

units.leftText: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
units.rightText: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

units.leftText: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.
units.rightText: This greeting is in my own hand — Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.

units.leftText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
units.rightText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
